failure_schedule: One-slot outbound queue and one-slot real SendSequence Pack admission form a forced dependency. Only the test disables the NIC timeout to remove packet-loss escape. ACK-only controls pass; four data+ACK cases fail before and pass after.
fix: Injection/GRO Flush already transfers segments to the gVisor dispatcher. Clear bounded producer bookkeeping without acquiring endpoint ownership. Keep shard ordering, GRO flush, producer yields, fixed queues and wait timeout unchanged.
lifecycle: Each row cancels and joins its workers, waits for gVisor stack shutdown, and returns captured pool roots after injection workers finish. Final focused selection includes bounded/unbounded outbound wait, cancel/close wake, ACK-only, IPv4/IPv6, cadence, and PacketBuffer release guards.
observable_progress: Established gVisor TCP connection emits the cumulative ACK for its only 2000-byte tail before application Read, then returns exactly those bytes. Both Write and two-segment WriteBatch cover user-owned and processor-owned endpoints, with no later payload injected.
physical_diagnostics: Frozen physical duplex A/B/A remains censored and interrupted outcomes are retained separately. Fresh-process first-arm stall excludes prior-arm fixed-port state as a prerequisite. No post-fix physical throughput claim is made by these root tests.
raw_stack_policy: stacks.txt is local diagnostic data; archive sanitized causal/numerical summary instead of raw pointer/path stack dump.
retention: Raw logs, source and overlay contents, binaries, commands, absolute paths, and stacks remain outside this sanitized archive. Only hashes and normalized outcomes are retained.
root_cause: Post-injection endpoint LockUser waits behind endpoint-owned outbound writes. Outbound queue draining can wait for Transfer Pack admission that needs a carrier ACK behind the blocked receive callback. ACK-only bypass leaves data+ACK affected.
